sample_unit: paired urinalysis and urine culture cases (held-out test set)
unlisted_practices: Using a rule-based decision tree on urinalysis parameters as a reflex protocol to reduce inappropriate urine cultures (diagnostic stewardship)

screen.reason: The study develops and deploys a decision tree algorithm (PittUDT) across multiple sites to optimize urinalysis parameters for reflex urine culturing in diagnostic stewardship. It evaluates model accuracy and diagnostic stewardship performance without testing a distinct deployment guardrail.
